partners.note: partners:read copies partner master, capital, and commitments already on /capital. Allocated income / expense / unrealized stay unset without a named [[partner_cut]] — never a silent 1/N of book NAV. A figure that will not divide stays unset, not rounded.

statements.note: statements:read is how closed-through is read. A missing close is unset, not a fake closed period. This app does not replace ratio close.

nav.note: nav:read copies NavStrike and the period roll-forward already on the book. A missing strike is unset, not NAV 0.00. An empty journal digest is unset, not history-intact. Commitment and undrawn cancel in NAV — they are not cash that arrived.

books.note: books:read lists books the subject can see. Membership is the AuthKit sub on the book. An org_id claim is not membership. The other three scopes still cite a named book when books:read is absent.

drip.note: Drip elections stay leftover on #161 / #177. This app is read-only capital / statement / NAV cites. It does not package distribute_* then subscribe_* and it does not mint an LP election.

irr_tvpi_waterfall.note: IRR, TVPI, and a waterfall stay refused. partners:read is not a return and not preferred-return math.

kernel_portal.note: No HTML portal routes inside ratio watch or the console binary. No LP user tables. No document vault in core. Membership is the AuthKit sub on the book.

payments.note: No drip payment initiation. payments:initiate is a hard non-scope. Bank OAuth stays refused.

grant_path.note: first-party Connect apps call ConnectApiUrl with a verified Connect access token (authorization_code or client_credentials against WorkOS Connect). Membership still required. A Connect token never takes RATIO_DEMO_OPEN and never matches org:{id}. leftover #22: WorkOS dashboard registration, DEMO_MEMBERS naming a live WorkOS sub, unused Cognito CloudFormation resources.
